verified_experience: 18 years (stated on the Yashoda Hospitals doctor profile)
hni_signals: Very strong leadership stack, all published verbatim by hospitals: at Yashoda Hitec City he is 'Sr Consultant Neonatologist, HOD - Department of Neonatology And Clinical Director' - note that is THREE seniority markers at once (Senior Consultant + Head of Department + Clinical Director), and Clinical Director is an institutional management role above ordinary consultant grade. Separately, Fernandez Hospital publishes him as 'Lead Consultant and Head of the Department of Neonatology' - i.e. he holds a departmental headship at TWO different Hyderabad hospital groups. Elite academic pedigree: MBBS and MD Paediatrics from Kurnool Medical College, then DM (Neonatology) from AIIMS New Delhi - a DM from AIIMS is a top-tier national super-specialty credential and rare in this dataset. Research-active with a ResearchGate profile that itself carries the 'HOD' designation, and he is attached to the Fernandez Neonatology academics/fellowship programme, i.e. he trains fellows - a faculty/teaching role. Subspecialty leadership in high-acuity, high-revenue NICU care (extreme preterm, neonatal hemodynamics, nitric oxide therapy, mechanical and non-invasive ventilation). Speaks Telugu, Hindi and English. No published procedure volume figure was found, so none is recorded; no evidence of a privately owned clinic.
